ALTER PROC [EDS].[SP_DATE_DIM_UPD] @STARTDATE [DATE],@ENDDATE [DATE] AS

BEGIN


/*==========================================================================================*/

DECLARE @sqlquery NVARCHAR(4000);
SET @sqlquery = 
'CREATE TABLE D360.DATE_DIM_BU_'+CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS date) , 112)+'
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION=REPLICATE)
AS SELECT * 
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM;'

--SELECT @sqlquery

EXEC sp_executesql @sqlquery;

update EDS.DATE_DIM set Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' where fulldate between @STARTDATE and @ENDDATE;


update EDS.DATE_DIM set Business_Day_Flag = 'N' where weekday in (1,7) and fulldate between @STARTDATE and @ENDDATE;

update EDS.DATE_DIM set Business_Day_Flag = 'N' 
where fulldate between @STARTDATE and @ENDDATE AND 
fulldate in ( SELECT HOLIDAY_DATE FROM  EDS.HOLIDAY_DIM
);
--fulldate in (
--  '2023-01-01', '2023-02-24', '2023-04-10', '2023-04-06', '2023-04-07', '2023-04-21'
--, '2023-05-01', '2023-06-12', '2023-08-21', '2023-08-28', '2023-10-30', '2023-11-01'
--, '2023-11-02', '2023-11-27', '2023-12-08', '2023-12-25', '2023-12-26', '2023-12-30'
--
--, '2024-01-01', '2024-02-09', '2024-03-28', '2024-03-29', '2024-04-09', '2024-04-10'
--, '2024-05-01', '2024-06-12', '2024-06-17'
--, '2024-08-26', '2024-08-23', '2024-11-30', '2024-11-01'
--, '2024-12-24', '2024-12-25', '2024-12-30', '2024-12-31'
--
--, '2025-01-01', '2025-01-29', '2025-03-31', '2025-04-09'
--, '2025-04-17', '2025-04-18', '2025-04-19', '2025-05-01'
--, '2025-06-07', '2025-06-12', '2025-08-21', '2025-08-25'
--, '2025-01-01', '2025-11-30', '2025-12-08', '2025-12-25'
--, '2025-12-30', '2025-12-31'
--
--);
--	Previous Business Day

UPDATE EDS.DATE_DIM
SET Previous_Business_Day = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Previous_Business_Date AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM (
		SELECT DateSK
			, Business_Day_Flag
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
				Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND 1 Preceding) Previous_Business_Date                     
		FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
		WHERE YEAR(fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
    ) AS Business_Day
WHERE DATE_DIM.DateSK = Business_Day.DateSK AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Week

UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Week = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Previous_Business_Week AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
   (
		SELECT DateSK
			, Business_Day_Flag
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND 7 Preceding) Previous_Business_Week                     
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.DateSK = Business_Day.DateSK AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Month

UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Month = DATEADD(month, -1, fulldate)
WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Month = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, fulldate
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Month = Business_Day.fulldate AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Month

UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Quarter = DATEADD(month, -3, fulldate)
WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Quarter = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, fulldate
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Quarter = Business_Day.fulldate AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	Previous Year

UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Year = DATEADD(month, -12, fulldate)
WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);
               
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET Previous_Year = CAST(CAST(Business_Day.Latest_Business_Day AS VARCHAR(8)) AS DATE)
FROM 
	(
		SELECT DateSK
			, fulldate
			, Max(CASE WHEN Business_Day_Flag = 'Y' THEN DateSK ELSE NULL END)
						Over (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY DateSK ROWS BETWEEN Unbounded Preceding AND CURRENT ROW) Latest_Business_Day
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR(fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
	) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Previous_Year = Business_Day.fulldate AND YEAR(DATE_DIM.fulldate) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--	*****

WITH PREV_WEEK AS (
SELECT YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_MONTH AS (
SELECT YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_YEAR AS (
SELECT YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y' AND YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE)-1 AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2022','2023','2024')
GROUP BY
YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
)
UPDATE DD
SET Previous_Week_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,COALESCE(PW.LATEST_BDATE,PM.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE))) ,
Previous_Month_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,COALESCE(PM.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE))), 
Previous_Year_Last_Bus_Day = (CONVERT(VARCHAR,PY.LATEST_BDATE)) 

FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD 
LEFT JOIN PREV_WEEK PW
ON (DATEPART(WEEK,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PW.WEEKOFYEAR AND PW.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_MONTH PM
ON (DATEPART(MONTH,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PM.MONTH AND PM.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_YEAR PY
ON (DATEPART(YEAR,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PY.YEAR 
WHERE DD.YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) --IN ('2023','2024');


--UPDATE RBB_Previous_Week
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET RBB_Previous_Week = business_day.Previous_Business_Week
FROM 
   (
		SELECT Year, 
        CASE
            WHEN Month = 12 AND ISOWeekOfYear = 1 THEN 53
            ELSE ISOWeekOfYear
        END ISOWeekOfYear_Comp, 
        MIN(Previous_Business_Day) Previous_Business_Week
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
        GROUP BY year, 
            CASE
                WHEN Month = 12 AND ISOWeekOfYear = 1 THEN 53
                ELSE ISOWeekOfYear
            END
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Year = Business_Day.Year AND             
        CASE
            WHEN Month = 12 AND Date_Dim.ISOWeekOfYear = 1 THEN 53
            ELSE Date_Dim.ISOWeekOfYear
        END = Business_Day.ISOWeekOfYear_Comp;

--UPDATE RBB_Previous_Month
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET RBB_Previous_Month = business_day.Previous_Business_Week
FROM 
   (
		SELECT Year, Month, MIN(Previous_Business_Day) Previous_Business_Week
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
        GROUP BY year, Month
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Year = Business_Day.Year
AND Date_Dim.Month = Business_Day.Month;

--UPDATE RBB_Previous_Quarter
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET RBB_Previous_Quarter = business_day.Previous_Business_Week
FROM 
   (
		SELECT Year, Quarter, MIN(Previous_Business_Day) Previous_Business_Week
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
        GROUP BY year, Quarter
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Year = Business_Day.Year
AND Date_Dim.Quarter = Business_Day.Quarter;

--UPDATE RBB_Previous_Year
UPDATE EDS.Date_Dim
SET RBB_Previous_Year = business_day.Previous_Business_Week
FROM 
   (
		SELECT Year, MIN(Previous_Business_Day) Previous_Business_Week
		FROM EDS.Date_Dim
		WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE)
        GROUP BY year
   ) AS Business_Day
WHERE Date_Dim.Year = Business_Day.Year;



--INITIAL UPDATE MONTH_END
UPDATE EDS.DATE_DIM
SET MONTH_END = 'N'
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

--UPDATE MONTH_END
UPDATE A
SET MONTH_END = 'Y'
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM A
JOIN (SELECT FULLDATE,DATESK,YYYYMM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY YYYYMM ORDER BY DATESK DESC) RN FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' ) B
    ON A.DATESK = B.DATESK AND B.RN = 1 AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR,YEAR) BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);



--INITIAL UPDATE CURRENT_MONTH_END
UPDATE EDS.DATE_DIM
SET CURRENT_MONTH_END = NULL
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);


--UPDATE CURRENT_MONTH_END
UPDATE A
SET CURRENT_MONTH_END = B.FULLDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM A
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATESK,FULLDATE,CURRENT_MONTH_END,MONTH FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR BETWEEN YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE) AND MONTH_END = 'Y') B
    ON A.MONTH = B.MONTH
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN  YEAR(@STARTDATE) AND YEAR(@ENDDATE);

/*==========================================================================================*/

END
GO
